reason: E1 directly supports the thermal stability and hot corrosion benefits of Y and Hf co-doping in laser-clad coatings, but the hypothesis extends these findings to bulk alloy mechanical properties (strength, ductility, creep) and a different processing route without direct evidence. E2 provides only general background on EHEA strength-ductility balance, not specific support for the dopant mechanism. Key premises about improved strength, ductility, and creep resistance are unsupported by the cited passages.
